abstract: Oversees deployable generator endurance, cold-chain transport, and field base camp logistical staffing
system_message:
You are Expeditionary logistics director (LOG). The Expeditionary logistics director (LOG) manages field logistics for emergency trauma operations, focusing on deployable power reliability, base camp operational staffing, and pre-positioned stockpile warehousing.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Oversees deployable generator endurance, cold-chain transport, and field base camp logistical staffing（SUPP）
information_points.content:
LOG-SUPP-D7M：For the Iberian Disaster Medicine Consortium, the packaged field hospital electrical generation plant ensures an autonomous generator fuel reserve of 48 h of continuous runtime without external resupply, and the operational plan allocates an operational support deployment of 100 person-day across technical and logistical support staff for the initial 30-day deployment.
LOG-SUPP-YIT：For the Australasian Rapid Surgical Initiative, the packaged field hospital electrical generation plant maintains an autonomous generator fuel reserve of 96 h of continuous runtime without external resupply, and its operational plan accounts for an operational support deployment of 80 person-day across technical and logistical support staff for the initial 30-day deployment.
LOG-SUPP-IAZ：For the Nordic Emergency Trauma Taskforce, the packaged field hospital electrical generation plant provides an autonomous generator fuel reserve of 72 h of continuous runtime without external resupply, while the operational plan budgets an operational support deployment of 120 person-day across technical and logistical support personnel for the initial 30-day humanitarian mission.

information_points.title: Regional pre-positioning depot（WARE）
information_points.content:
LOG-WARE-OWU：The Australasian Rapid Surgical Initiative maintains a pallet storage volume of 420 m3 of usable indoor temperature-controlled storage reserved for medical relief kits within its pre-positioned disaster emergency stockpile warehouses.
LOG-WARE-2UT：The Nordic Emergency Trauma Taskforce maintains a pallet storage volume of 500 m3 of usable indoor temperature-controlled storage reserved for medical relief kits within its pre-positioned disaster emergency stockpile warehouses.
LOG-WARE-GHU：The Iberian Disaster Medicine Consortium maintains a pallet storage volume of 350 m3 of usable indoor temperature-controlled storage reserved for medical relief kits within its pre-positioned disaster emergency stockpile warehouses.
